patterns.fingerprint_regex: Invalid issue branch name|Invalid issue-style branch
pint .* returned with error code 1|Laravel Pint
patterns.prevention: CI-parity autofixes changed PHP with Pint, then composer lint verifies canonical formatting.

patterns.fingerprint_regex: phpstan|Found [0-9]+ errors|unresolvable type|Cannot call method .* on string
patterns.prevention: CI-parity runs PHPStan before push and focused domain tests before the full backend suite.
Every affected Customer, Driver and Van app runs dart format plus flutter analyze before push.
Diff-selected focused Laravel tests run before the full backend suite.

patterns.fingerprint_regex: tests passed, [1-9][0-9]* failed|TestFailure|Test timed out after
patterns.prevention: Diff-selected Flutter tests run first, then the full affected app test suite.

patterns.fingerprint_regex: google_fonts was unable to load font|fonts\.gstatic\.com
patterns.detector: flutter test under Flutter test binding
patterns.prevention: Tests must not rely on successful external font/network fetching; network-backed typography is never assertion authority.
CI tools are pinned to an explicit version and upgraded intentionally.
Do not rerun unchanged deterministic red state; reproduce through CI-parity and promote a stable detector.
